text: Calling about my son, 6. He's running 38.5 this evening. He won't settle down to sleep tonight, keeps getting up, but apart from that he's his usual self. He's got a few insect bites on his legs that he's scratching. I did the glass test on them anyway and they all go pale under it. Mostly after advice on whether to give anything for the itching alongside the paracetamol.
